_about: The dashboard's building blocks, from the Canva design 'SaaS Dashboard UI Desktop Prototype' (DAHYT0i6X68). Page = header (business name, dashboard tabs, greeting), title, subtitle, Filter button; then ABOVE THE FOLD the KPI row (1-4 cards), then container rows (any mix of the patterns below, as many rows as there are visuals). Widths are columns of a 6-column grid (phones: one column). layout.py picks and fills them; Dashboard.tsx and page.html draw them.

1.note: one KPI, with a trend container beside it in the same row

kpi_styles.number: the title and the big number (no earlier period to compare with)
kpi_styles.change: the title, the number and the change vs. the previous range (percentages in points)
kpi_styles.gauge: a half-circle dial 0-100% with the target band; only when every KPI on the row is a percentage
kpi_styles._rule: one style per dashboard (layout.py kpi_style), so the KPI row looks consistent

visual_priority: horizontal bar chart: categories (names on the left, value at the end of each bar)
